scenes.text: Divide hundreds, then tens, then ones. Check every answer by multiplication.
Calculate 336 divided by 6. The answer is 56. 6 times 56 equals 336.
A club during a reading competition shares 531 pencils equally among 9 teams. How many per team? Pause the video and think.
A club during a reading competition shares 531 pencils equally among 9 teams. How many per team? The answer is 59. 9 times 59 equals 531.
